name: s3:GetObjectVersion on arn:aws:s3:::* (all buckets) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression: arn:aws:s3:::* names every bucket in the account (resource-id head is '*'), so a bulk read on it reaches all/nearly-all objects - as broad as Resource:'*'. Previously resourceIsBroad() saw only the bare '*' as broad and this returned CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). DATA-EXFIL must fire and the CLI must exit non-zero. Uses the s3:GetObjectVersion member of the bulk-read catalog.
